title: fix(plugin-audit, platform-objects): label record pointers "Record" and the import job error "Failure Reason"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1aerzimQKmxjarmWGsK9XD)_

Fixes #28353
Fixes #28113

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审计日志（sys_audit_log）与活动（sys_activity）的 `record_id` 字段显示名由 “Record ID” 改为 “Record”（中文 “记录”、日文 “レコード”、西班牙文 “Registro”）；导入任务（sys_import_job）的 `error` 字段显示名由 “Fatal Error” 改为 “Failure Reason”（“失败原因”、“失敗理由”、“Motivo del fallo”）。
- 为什么改：审计日志列表和活动详情里这一列画的是目标记录的图标和名称，表头却写 “Record ID”；导入任务全部行失败时 `error` 里是一句 “每行都失败了，原因见结果” 的说明，标成 “Fatal Error” 会让管理员去找一次崩溃。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示名；字段名、类型、存储、查询、种子数据、指针对都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts（record_id 的 label）、packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-import-job.object.ts（error 的 label）、packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts（两处 record_id）。
- 两分钟验证：在 Console 打开 Setup › 审计日志，四个列表视图的表头显示 “Record”（中文界面 “记录”）；打开任一导入任务记录，Outcome 分组里显示 “Failure Reason”（中文 “失败原因”）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_audit_log.record_id` and `sys_activity.record_id` (plugin-audit): label `'Record ID'` becomes `'Record'`. Both are the id half of an ActivityPointer pair (`referenceVia: 'object_name'`), so the console draws the cell as the target record (its object's icon and name) in the audit log's `recent`, `writes_only`, `record_views` and `all_events` list views and on an activity's Details tab. The header now agrees with the cell. `sys_audit_log.record_id`'s `description` ("ID of the affected record") is left as it is: it describes the stored value, and the ruling moves labels only.
- `sys_import_job.error` (platform-objects): label `'Fatal Error'` becomes `'Failure Reason'`. Since the every-row-failed ruling the column holds either the fatal error that aborted the job or one sentence pointing at the job's `results`; the spec describe for `ImportJobProgressSchema.error` covers both, and the sibling `protocol.zod.ts` import describe already says "Failure reason, when failed". No other label in the repo names this thing, so the card's example "Failure Reason" was kept.
- English bundles regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (after rebuilding the two packages): across all ten bundle packages, the only diff is the three English leaves above.
- Hand translations: zh-CN 记录 ID → 记录, ja-JP レコード ID → レコード, es-ES ID de registro → Registro (the words `sys_approval_action.record_id` and PR #28347 use); zh-CN 致命错误 → 失败原因, ja-JP 致命的なエラー → 失敗理由, es-ES Error fatal → Motivo del fallo. None of these leaves has a source-hash entry in any locale, so no provenance table moves.
- `sys_mail_association.record_id` (service-mailbox) keeps "Record ID", as ruled: its record page shows it only in the highlights strip, which prints the stored id.
- Changesets: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/sys-audit-log-pointer-pair.test.ts` (where the pair is already pinned): a new block asserts both objects' `record_id` label is "Record", that the field stays the text id half resolved through `object_name`, and that the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES bundle leaves read Record / 记录 / レコード / Registro.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-import-job-error-label.test.ts` (new; no test pinned this object in its package): the `error` label is "Failure Reason", the field stays an optional textarea in the Outcome group, and the four bundle leaves read Failure Reason / 失败原因 / 失敗理由 / Motivo del fallo.
- Red first on `main` (`23d1303d`, test commit `56131cbf` only): plugin-audit pointer-pair file 10 failed | 12 passed; import-job file 5 failed (each `Expected "Record"` / `"Failure Reason"`, `Received "Record ID"` / `"Fatal Error"`). Green at the fix: 22/22 and 5/5.

## Acceptance notes

- These pins assert display copy, which the order asks for and which this package family already does for labels (`sys-audit-log-action-labels.test.ts`, `sys-notification-display-labels.test.ts`). Each pin also asserts the field's unchanged type and pointer, so a label edit cannot ride along with a storage change.
- No open PR touches the edited object or bundle files at the time this PR was opened.
